name: io
description: Returns a fluent emitter for a WebSocket channel — sugar over the same registry the wsPublish built-in uses. The channel argument is optional inside a channel handler, where io() with no argument refers to the current channel. The emitter supports emitting to the whole channel, to a specific room, excluding a connection, counting members, listing connection ids, and reading the presence roster. Only available in serve mode, where a live registry is present.

params.name: channel
params.description: The channel to emit on, e.g. "/chat". Inside a channel handler this defaults to the current channel.

links.title: RustCFML WebSocket documentation
links.description: Full documentation of the RustCFML realtime engine, including the fluent io() emitter.

examples.title: Emit to the whole channel and to a room
examples.description: The fluent emitter scopes fan-out with to(), excepts a connection with except(), and inspects the channel with count(), sockets(), and presence().

examples.title: Use io() inside a channel handler
examples.description: Inside a handler, io() with no argument refers to the current channel.
